Mohit (Product): Quick heads-up — we're rolling out a change to how burst usage and free credits are represented on invoices. Effective 2026-04-15 for new invoices, opt-in beta starts next week. Short summary below.

Carla (Finance): Quick q — will this change line item structure or just labels?

Mohit (Product): Both. New invoices will include a compact 'burst_bucket_minutes' line item and a 'credit_rollforward' section when applicable. This makes per-minute burst billing explicit instead of mixing into general usage.

Ajay (Eng): Will quota enforcement change? i.e. do rate limits move from token-based to minute-bucket checks?

Mohit (Product): No change to per-request rate limits. We are introducing a parallel "bucket" accounting layer for burstable minutes — enforcement stays separate. The runtime will credit/debit buckets for short high-throughput periods to make costs predictable.

Tim (Customer Success): How are free credits handled? Customers keep unused credits rolled forward?

Mohit (Product): We're introducing a 90-day rollforward window for promotional credits (up from expiry-on-month-end). Credits will auto-roll for 90 days after issuance, and be shown on invoices as a single rollforward line. This applies to credits issued after the rollout.

Carla (Finance): Any change to overage policy?

Mohit (Product): Yes — we are tightening the automatic overage grace from 48h to 24h for transient spikes. For customers on Dedicated or Enterprise we keep negotiated terms. Also introducing a one-time "first-month spike" waiver for new signups during their trial (handled programmatically).

billing-bot: Migration job queued for invoice schema v2. ETA ~2h for the first 5k accounts. Logs: /internal/billing/migrations/1835.

Ajay (Eng): Need an API header update for clients parsing invoices?

Mohit (Product): We'll add an "X-Redwood-Invoice-Version" header for API responses; SDKs will detect and fallback. Docs and sample payload below. Please don't rely on field order — use keys.

Mohit (Product): Sample invoice snippet (for reference):
```json
{
  "invoice_id": "inv_1234",
  "lines": [
    {"code": "usage_text", "description": "tokens", "amount": "125.40"},
    {"code": "burst_bucket_minutes", "description": "minute-bursts (pool: shared-main)", "minutes": "12", "amount": "6.00"}
  ],
  "credits": {"applied": "10.00", "rollforward_window_days": "90"}
}
```

Tim (Customer Success): I'll draft the customer email and in-console banner. @Carla can you approve messaging for invoices?

Carla (Finance): Yep, I'll review. Make sure the sample invoice language is clear.

Ops (Platform): We'll schedule a migration-safe rollout: beta flag -> small percent -> full. I'll post the rollout timeline to #release-war-room.

Mohit (Product): Action items:
- Tim: customer comms and banner (ETA 48h)
- Ajay: SDK backwards-compat checks (ETA 72h)
- Carla: invoice language approval (ETA 24h)
- Ops: migration window + jobs (start next Tue)

Mohit (Product): Thanks all. If you spot anything risky in the sample invoice format or the credit roll policy, flag it here. :eyes:
